name: Control-It Community Modules
description: Official community registry of open-source hardware & software control modules for the Control-It iOS app.

modules.name: Behringer X32 / M32
modules.author: Control It Team
modules.subtitle: Digital Audio Mixing Console
modules.descriptionText: Control channel mutes, faders, DCA groups, scene recalls, and main output on Behringer X32 and Midas M32 audio consoles via OSC/UDP.

modules.name: Blackmagic ATEM
modules.author: Control It Team
modules.subtitle: Broadcast Video Switcher Control
modules.descriptionText: Control Cut, Auto transitions, program bus, preview bus, downstream keyers, and macros on ATEM mini, Television Studio, and Constellation switchers via direct UDP persistent connection with real-time tally.

modules.name: REST API & Webhooks
modules.author: Control It Team
modules.subtitle: Universal HTTP / JSON Endpoint Gateway
modules.descriptionText: Universal REST API client for sending GET, POST, PUT, DELETE requests and cloud webhooks (Zapier, Make, IFTTT, n8n, Node-RED, Custom Servers).

modules.name: Home Assistant
modules.author: Control It Team
modules.subtitle: Smart Home, IoT & Studio Relays
modules.descriptionText: Trigger smart relays, power sockets, studio on-air lights, scene automations, and webhooks via Home Assistant REST / WebSocket API.

modules.name: OBS Studio
modules.author: Control It Team
modules.subtitle: Video Switcher & Streaming Control
modules.descriptionText: Control scenes, sources, audio, streaming, and recording on OBS Studio 28+ via direct persistent WebSocket connection with instant tally feedback.

modules.name: Philips Hue
modules.author: Control It Team
modules.subtitle: Smart Lighting & Studio Tally Illumination
modules.descriptionText: Control smart bulbs, light strips, color scenes, brightness, and tally alerts via local Philips Hue Bridge API.

modules.name: ProPresenter 7
modules.author: Control It Team
modules.subtitle: Live Presentation & Lyrics Control
modules.descriptionText: Control slides, stage displays, media playlists, clear layers, and triggers on Renewed Vision ProPresenter 7 via direct API / WebSocket.

modules.name: Spotify
modules.author: Control It Team
modules.subtitle: Music Playback & Pre-show Audio
modules.descriptionText: Control pre-service background music, playback states, track skips, and volume via Spotify Web API.

modules.name: VLC Media Player
modules.author: Control It Team
modules.subtitle: Video & Audio File Player
modules.descriptionText: Control video roll-ins, playback pause/resume, stop, fullscreen, and playlist item triggers on VLC Media Player via HTTP / TCP interface.

modules.name: vMix
modules.author: Control It Team
modules.subtitle: Live Video Production Software
modules.descriptionText: Trigger transitions, active inputs, overlays, titles, and audio mixing on vMix Live Production software via HTTP / TCP API.

modules.name: ZoomOSC
modules.author: Control It Team
modules.subtitle: Video Conferencing & Meeting Automation
modules.descriptionText: Control Zoom meetings, pin/spotlight participants, manage gallery views, mute participants, and send in-meeting commands via ZoomOSC.
